fees.name: Entry visa (single-entry, up to 15 days) - Group 8 (e.g. USA)
fees.applies: USA, Gabon, Kyrgyzstan and other Group 8 nationalities
fees.notes: Reported by travel-agency and news sites as issued under Syrian Ministry of Interior Decree No. 148/8 (effective July 6, 2025), applying entry visa fees at all airports and land borders by nationality-based reciprocity tiers. Could not independently verify on an official Syrian government portal - evisa.sy shows 'Coming Soon' and returned a certificate error; mofaex.gov.sy (Ministry of Foreign Affairs eServices) had no fee schedule; the U.S. Embassy Damascus visas page returned an error page. Amount unverified against a primary source; treat as indicative only.

free_visa_notes: Some nationalities (e.g. Jordan, Lebanon, Malaysia, Mauritania per secondary reporting - 'Group 1') are reported as visa-fee-exempt for stays up to 6 months, but this has not been confirmed on an official Syrian government source. No official confirmation exists that Syria has a general visa-free regime; a visa (paid, reciprocity-tiered) is understood to be required for most nationalities under Ministry of Interior Decree No. 148/8 (reported effective 2025-07-06), pending official verification. IMPORTANT: This entire fee schedule is sourced from post-2024-transition secondary/travel-industry reporting because Syria's official e-visa portal (evisa.sy) is not operational and no other official fee schedule could be located as of 2026-07-02. Confidence is set to low; this record should be re-verified once evisa.sy or another official Syrian government page publishes a fee table.
